scheme_name: Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 25 R.I.R. Bird’s Unit, 100 Broiler Bird’s Unit and Stipend for Poultry Farming Training for Scheduled Caste People
other_conditions: Must have completed a 6‑day poultry farming training
Beneficiaries below Poverty Line (BPL) will be given priority
benefits_summary: Provides up to 75% subsidy (maximum ₹6,000) for a 25 R.I.R. bird unit, up to 90% subsidy (maximum ₹36,000) for a 100 broiler bird unit, and a stipend of up to ₹2,000 for poultry farming training, each payable to one family member.
